one_line: Abyssinian-born regent of Ahmadnagar who led agile Deccan cavalry and hill warfare against the Mughal Empire.

appearance.age_look: mid-50s, lean but wiry, a seasoned commander with a straight, disciplined posture
appearance.face: oval face, deep brown complexion, strong cheekbones, neatly trimmed grey-black beard and moustache, calm intense eyes with slightly furrowed brows, default expression focused yet dignified
appearance.hair: short, tightly curled black hair peppered with grey, mostly concealed under a deep indigo turban wrapped close to the skull with a small gold turban ornament at the front
appearance.costume: He wears a long, knee-length white cotton jama (Mughal-style robe) with cross-tied front and flared skirt, over a fitted pale grey angarkha-style inner tunic; a broad dark maroon cloth patka sash wraps his waist, knotted to the left with the ends hanging; over this he has a sleeveless, hip-length quilted armour vest in muted steel-grey with simple vertical stitching, historically plausible light protection rather than fantasy plate; loose white churidar trousers gather neatly at the ankles; his feet are in brown leather Deccani mojari shoes with modest upturned toes; he has a simple gold signet ring on the right hand and small gold hoop earrings, but no excessive jewellery, giving a practical commander’s look.
appearance.signature: A slightly curved Deccani talwar with a dark steel blade, a plain brass hilt and a maroon-wrapped grip, sheathed in a brown leather scabbard that hangs from his left hip at an angle from his maroon sash.

ref_desc: Malik Ambar is a mid-50s Abyssinian commander with a deep brown face, short curled hair under a deep indigo turban, white jama, maroon sash, grey quilted vest, white churidar, brown mojari shoes, and a curved talwar with brass hilt in a brown scabbard.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character of Malik Ambar: a mid-50s, lean Abyssinian commander with an oval, deep brown face, strong cheekbones, intense calm eyes, and a neatly trimmed grey-black beard. His short, tightly curled hair is mostly hidden by a deep indigo turban wrapped close to the head with a small gold ornament at the front. He wears a long knee-length white cotton jama with cross-tied front over a pale grey inner tunic, cinched by a broad dark maroon sash knotted to his left, its ends hanging. Over the jama is a sleeveless hip-length quilted armour vest in muted steel grey with simple vertical stitching, and he has loose white churidar trousers tucked into brown leather Deccani mojari shoes with modest upturned toes. Add a simple gold signet ring and small gold hoop earrings for subtle status. At his left hip hangs his signature weapon: a slightly curved Deccani talwar with dark steel blade, plain brass hilt, maroon-wrapped grip, sheathed in a brown leather scabbard. Show him in a neutral, dignified stance that clearly displays his face, turban, full costume from head to toe, and the talwar and its colours.
